question: For every 2027 projection, how trustworthy is it BEFORE you act on it?
method: Transparency (RBP conversation: per-prediction reliability) from committed PRIOR-season data only. input_stability = spread of committed prior-season contact% (tight if <5.0 pts) and BB% (tight if <3.0 pts) across 2+ seasons; HIGH=BOTH tight, MEDIUM=one, LOW=neither, NO_PRIOR=no committed 2-season record. projected PA (proj_PA) is deliberately NOT used because in this committed artifact it is a uniform 500-PA default for all 201 — an invented workload axis would reproduce the opacity this layer exists to remove.
caveat: A HIGH/MEDIUM is a confidence LABEL from committed inputs, not a guaranteed outcome. The 121 players with no committed 2-season record are honestly labeled NO_PRIOR (cap below HIGH), because guessing high for a player we have no history on would be the black-box behavior this layer is built to stop.
sources: MIT RBP: Prediction with Transparency — Offensive Value in Baseball (2025), docs/LITERATURE_SPINE.md [18]
